by_strategy.description: Return no claims at all (would max out an "abstention" metric).
Cite every retrieved source, including the author-derived note.
Repeat the same claim twice with the right sources.
Cite the other product's label summary.
Cite a source id that was never retrieved.
Keep the sources but declare the other product id.
Cite exactly the independently expected sources (control).

notes: Expected claims and sources are the app's own server-side definitions; agreement measures contract enforcement, not scientific truth.
Grid C drafts are scripted by the authors to probe the verifier. They are not observed model behaviour.
Clinical release stays blocked in every run; no eval changes that gate.
